title: Astonishing Scavenger Hunt: Surf, Sand and Sculptures!
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
Digital Copies of your adventure hunt photos
Photo challenges for each player - choose between Braniac, Photographer, Mapper
Let's Roam App access for maps, photo challenges, riddles and leaderboards
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Weather Check: Check the weather forecast for the day of your hunt and dress appropriately. Comfortable shoes and weather appropriate attire are recommended
Please note that this is a self-guided private tour so you can start at any time and at your own pace
Fully Charged Devices: Make sure your smartphone is fully charged before the tour as you’ll be using it to navigate and interact with the app. Please bring a power bank if you need it.
Booking Confirmation: Confirmation will be received at time of booking along with instructions on downloading the app and starting your adventure
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Hey thrill-seekers, buckle up for the ultimate scavenger hunt adventure with us—the undisputed champions of app-led quests! Picture this: you're out and about, exploring top landmarks and uncovering hidden gems while tackling brain-teasing trivia and taking on challenges that'll test your skills and wit.

Whether you're all about team spirit or crave that competitive edge, our hunts are designed to bring out the best in every player. Whether it’s a spontaneous outing, a wild bachelorette blowout, a rocking birthday bash, or a corporate team-building bonanza, we’ve got the perfect blend of fun and adventure waiting for you.

What makes it even better? Each player gets to choose their interactive role, with challenges as unique as their personality. So, round up your crew, download our app, and get ready to turn every outing into an unforgettable escapade. Let’s Roam—where every step leads to discovery, laughter, and epic memories!
